explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the optimizer stops exactly at `x['A1'] = 3000` instead of pushing A1 above that level, even though A1 has positive unit margin in `table_1.csv`. Trace the full logical-physical chain by naming the exact code variables (`x['A1']`, `watch`, `deep`, `excess` / their solver names), the exact CSV fields and parameter values from `general_parameters.csv` and `table_1.csv`, and the business brief terms they implement. Then use the LP-relaxation diagnostics to identify which revised constraints are binding at that solution, interpret the shadow prices/slacks of the production-days limit and the excess/watch gate, and compare against the original model to pinpoint the exact code additions that caused the objective to fall from 156483.0 to about 156000.0; quantify that drop using the displaced product mix and explain why the dual-based marginal value cannot be linearly extrapolated once `a1_watch_threshold` is crossed.
